priority: Numeric octree path order at each stage.
selection: All remaining HOLD leaves in numeric path order. Eight closed midpoint children each. Inherited geometry then at most two ranked marginal events then one highest-ranked pair/anchor overlap event per remaining child; same 512 slices at every round.
stop: Stop only on no HOLD, six completed rounds, or before a whole round would exceed 20000 new geometric cells. No partial round, no threshold changes, no event retuning. Every unresolved leaf is retained.
freeze_note: Internal freeze of contract, runner and inherited inputs before any new child evaluation; source PR122 results known. The new audit is written afterwards against the declared independent checks, not represented as preregistered.
audit_plan: Independent reconstruction of source cover and all paths; exact pair interval ranges; direct nine-moment center solves for every finite enclosure and corners of first eight per round; independent PMF and cover/cache/negative controls as inherited from PR122.
scope: One fixed rational reference in 2+1 Minkowski; nodes15/17/5 independently move in boosted x over [-0.1,0.1]^3. Excludes unchanged order AND inherited admissibility AND symmetric physical weight gap>1/5 AND full conditional labelled count/overlap-law TV<=1/4. Reference-vs-moved theorem only, not arbitrary pairs, other references, other directions, full selection likelihood or general GFEST stability.
